name: Zoho Expense
summary: Zoho Expense has a free plan for up to 3 users and paid plans at $3 and $5 a user each month on annual billing. Multiple expense policies and ACH reimbursement start on Standard, and advanced approvals sit on Premium.

facts.text: The free plan caps receipt scans at 20 per user a month and gives 5 GB of receipt storage.
Standard allows 200 scans per user a month and Premium allows 1,000.
Cash advances, ACH payments and direct bank reimbursements start on Standard.
Zoho states that Zoho Expense is ISO 27001 and SOC Type 2 certified.
The service is pay as you go with no contract, and Zoho says users can cancel any time.
The mileage page says a user taps start and stop to record a trip, and the app calculates the distance from it or from an odometer reading the user enters.
Mileage amounts are calculated from pre-set rates per mile or kilometer, and the help page says the vehicle's mileage rate is set by the admin.
Mileage expenses are added to a report through the Add to Report option, which can use an existing report or a new one.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 3 users and 20 receipt scans per user a month

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Billed annually; $4 on monthly billing. Adds multiple expense policies and bank reimbursements

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually; $6 on monthly billing. Adds advanced approval management and automatic mileage capture

hiddenCosts: Users who create expenses or reports are charged, even if they only submit.
Premium Support starts at $490 a year and Jumpstart starts at $500 a year.
The travel add-on costs $9.99 per trip.

contract.cancellation: Pay as you go with no contract; cancel any time.
